## PART I Item 1 As of June 30, 2024, we employed approximately 228,000 people on a full-time basis, 126,000 in the U.S. and 102,000 internationally. As a company, we will continue to lev erage data and research to inform decision making, balancing the needs of the business, team, and indiv idual. ## OPERATING SEGMENTS We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productiv ity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.
